description: This file defines a high-level Swift class 'TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer' that manages text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer. It provides methods to speak text asynchronously with timeout handling, manage speech state, and delegate AVSpeechSynthesizer events. The class is designed to be a singleton and encapsulates speech control, including stopping and timeout handling.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class managing text-to-speech synthesis with asynchronous control, timeouts, and delegate handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops current speech, cancels timeout watchdog, and resets state.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Asynchronously speaks the provided text with optional language and start callback, implementing a watchdog timeout.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Static method estimating speech duration per character for different languages to implement a timeout.
